_comment: Dispositions of advisories that are KNOWN, reviewed and DEFERRED. Every entry must be dev-only (checked against package-lock.json on every run). Adding an entry needs a written justification and a reviewer; an advisory outside this list FAILS the audit gate. This list does not make the dependency tree vulnerability-free.

packages.braces: GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm; no patched release. Root cause of the chain below. Reachable only through lint/build tooling.
packages.micromatch: Depends on braces (same root cause); dev-only.
packages.fast-glob: Depends on micromatch (same root cause); dev-only.
packages.chokidar: Depends on braces (same root cause); only inside tailwindcss' file watcher; dev-only.
packages.tailwindcss: Pulled in by chokidar/fast-glob (same root cause); a Tailwind major migration is out of scope; build-time only.
packages.tailwindcss-animate: Depends on tailwindcss (same root cause); build-time only.
packages.eslint-config-next: Depends on @next/eslint-plugin-next / fast-glob (same root cause); the offered fix is a semver-major DOWNGRADE (14.2.35), rejected; lint-only.
packages.@next/eslint-plugin-next: Depends on fast-glob (same root cause); lint-only.
